MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 9, 2023
  6201 APPIAN WAY
  LONG BEACH YACHT CLUB, 2:30 PM

Colin Kelly, Chair  Elizabeth Lambe, Commissioner
Jo Murray, Vice Chair  Bruce Mac Rae, Commissioner
Avis Atkins, Commissioner  Theresa Marino, Commissioner
Elizabeth Carlin, Commissioner  Sabrina Zavala, Commissioner
Gordana Kajer, Commissioner

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  23-24857  Recommendation to receive and file the Beach Maintenance, Queens Way Bay
  Employee Recognition presentation.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  23-24842  Recommendation to approve the Marine Advisory Commission minutes for the
  meeting held on Thursday, October 12, 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  23-24894  Recommendation to uphold June 8, 2023 Marine Advisory Commission approval of
  the replacement of a memorial bench in Basin 4 of Alamitos Bay Marina to honor
  Casey Richard Clark. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  23-24895  Recommendation to approve the placement of a new memorial bench in Overlook
  Park to honor Theresa, John and Corinne Revill. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  23-24851  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  23-24858  Recommendation to receive and file the Committee status reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.
